Name: Lift position readout
Subsystem: RobotState lift angle and the angle-to-height conversion, with battery, cliff and IMU
Purpose: The lift angle is reported in radians and converted with the engine's own formula. If the conversion is wrong, every docking height and the carry check are wrong with it.
ExpectedTelemetry: a reading at each end of the travel, and both ends of the travel actually visited
ExpectedPhysical: The two readings it prints back match where the lift actually was: about -0.198 rad / 32 mm down, about 0.712 rad / 92 mm raised.
Prerequisites: the lift is all the way down to begin with

sequence: lift sequence: down seen=yes, raised seen=yes, both ends seen=yes
down: lift down:    -0.189 rad /   32.6 mm   (engine: -0.198 rad / 32 mm)
raised: lift raised:   0.820 rad /   93.3 mm   (engine:  0.712 rad / 92 mm)
